title: Overlays
lead: Every overlay, live. Each one handles focus, keyboard dismissal and ARIA wiring for you, and closes itself when you leave this page.
modal-desc: A centered dialog: focus trap, scroll lock, and dismissal with Escape, a backdrop click or its close button. It is named after its first heading.
modal-body: Press Escape, click the backdrop, or use the close button to dismiss. Focus stays inside until then.
drawer-desc: A panel that slides in from a screen edge, with the same focus trap, scroll lock and dismissal as the modal.
emergency-desc: A modal that only closes programmatically: no close button, no backdrop click, no Escape. For things the user must consciously resolve.
emergency-body: Your session is about to expire. Escape and backdrop clicks do nothing here; only the button below closes this dialog.
blocking-loader-desc: A full-screen, non-dismissible loader. While it shows, the rest of the page is inert for keyboard and assistive-tech users too. This demo closes it after 2.5 seconds.
dropdown-desc: A menu anchored to its trigger. The trigger toggles it and gets aria-haspopup, aria-controls and aria-expanded. Arrow keys move between items and Escape closes it.
context-menu-desc: A menu that opens at the pointer on right-click of its trigger, replacing the native context menu there. The keyboard context-menu key or Shift+F10 work too.
context-menu-target: Right-click (or focus and press Shift+F10) in this area
popover-desc: Content anchored to a trigger. An interactive popover is a dialog that traps focus; a non-interactive one is a plain region. It closes on outside click or Escape.
popover-body: An interactive popover: focus moves inside and stays there until it closes.
tooltip-desc: Shown on hover or focus after a short delay and linked to its anchor through aria-describedby. It stays open while hovered and Escape dismisses it (WCAG 1.4.13).
snackbar-desc: Toast notifications announced through a live region. They auto-dismiss, pausing while hovered or focused, and get longer when they have an action button.
snackbar-info: Heads up: this is an informational toast.
banner-desc: A persistent banner region: items never auto-dismiss and stay until the user dismisses them.
banner-info: A new version of the documentation is available.
banner-error: We couldn't reach the server. Retrying won't lose your changes.
